purpose: Recover the v40 prospective mechanism and confirmation test without changing its algorithm, after permanently excluding every v40 partition ID whose aggregate labels and hops were accidentally disclosed.

integrity_lineage.boundary_interpretation: Source file hashes and all 18,171 public UIDs are known. Only v40 partition aggregate labels/hops were disclosed; those IDs are excluded. No non-v40 row content or gold aggregate informed this frozen recovery protocol.

frozen_partition.v40_exclusion: Compute v40 ordering exactly as SHA-256('FRC-HOVER-DYNAMIC-ATOMIC-ROLES-V40|' + uid), then uid; exclude the first 2512 IDs.
frozen_partition.eligible_pool: All remaining rows with unique non-empty uid and an official TF-IDF row with the same unique id. Do not compute claims, labels, hops, supporting facts, candidate titles, or candidate-ceiling statistics while constructing the ID pool.
frozen_partition.v41_ordering: Sort eligible IDs by SHA-256 of UTF-8 'FRC-HOVER-DYNAMIC-ATOMIC-ROLES-V41|' + uid, then uid.
frozen_partition.confirmation: Next 2000 v41-ordered IDs; do not prepare, generate, score, or join any content/gold until every pilot mechanism gate passes and an execution registration is written.

frozen_candidate_adapter.membership: Use only doc_retrieval_results[0][0][:20], Unicode-whitespace normalize, deduplicate in release order, and exact-resolve against the frozen database.
frozen_candidate_adapter.blindness: Prepared/query/scored caches exclude label, hop count, supporting facts, public titles, candidate-gold flags, gold units, and candidate ceiling.

frozen_dynamic_query_generator.prompt_and_parse_contract: Exactly the v40 prompt, exact-four-key strict JSON parser, whitespace normalization, 256-code-point truncation, and four fixed label-neutral fallback templates.

frozen_scoring.scores: BM25, dense cosine, hybrid RRF, direct cross-encoder, four v39 static verification roles, and four dynamic atomic queries.
frozen_scoring.calibration: Independent per-case min-max for every score column; stable candidate-id ties.

frozen_selector.v39_replay: Threshold 0.55, role coverage weight 2, direct relevance weight 1, original feasibility scan and candidate-id tie break.
frozen_selector.v41_source_constraint: At most one selected chunk per neutral source for both rank-coverage methods.
frozen_selector.rank_utility: 1/log2(2 + zero-based descending role-score rank), candidate-id tie break.
frozen_selector.static_dynamic_isolation: Only the four static versus dynamic score columns differ.

confirmation_evaluation.open_condition: All pilot mechanism checks pass and execution registration freezes source, ID commitments, pilot artifacts, census, code hashes, and runtime.
confirmation_evaluation.primary: document_evidence_f1 equally weighted over 512/1024/1500 token budgets
